# EcclesiaOS v1.0.40

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.40 improves first-run branding, language configuration, login presentation, and module navigation. Administrators can now choose the application subtitle and default application language from the setup and system settings interfaces. Individual users retain control of their own language preference, while disabled modules now disappear consistently from the navigation hierarchy.

## Configurable application branding

- Added an Application Subtitle field to the initial setup interface.
- Saved the setup subtitle into the church branding settings during installation.
- Added the Application Subtitle field to System Settings for later changes.
- Removed explanatory helper text from the Application Name and Application Subtitle controls for a cleaner settings layout.
- Updated the login page title and meta description to use the same application name and subtitle format as the landing page.
- Changed the Docker environment example to use `Church Management System` instead of the old `Enterprise Church Management System` default.
- Preserved custom church branding values across the landing page, login page, installer, and system settings.

## Default language settings

- Connected System Settings → Language to the application’s default locale.
- Added supported system defaults for English, French, and Spanish.
- Kept account-level language preferences as the higher-priority override for individual users.
- Preserved session and cookie locale selections for explicit visitor language choices.
- Added compatibility for existing legacy language values such as `English (US)`, `English (UK)`, `French`, and `Spanish`.
- Ensured Carbon date formatting follows the resolved application locale.

## Website Studio navigation

- Removed the Website Events entry from the Website Studio submenu.
- Updated navigation filtering so disabling a parent module hides the parent and every child entry.
- Kept the existing disabled-module route protection so hidden Website Studio routes remain unavailable when the module is disabled.
- Added regression coverage for the hidden Website Studio menu and removed Events submenu entry.

## Setup and administration reliability

- Preserved installer validation and existing church settings while saving the new subtitle.
- Kept existing system settings update and reset behavior compatible with the new language value format.
- Added regression coverage for installer subtitle rendering, system settings persistence, locale defaults, and account preference overrides.

## Upgrade impact

- No database migration is required.
- Existing churches continue using their saved branding and account language preferences.
- Existing legacy language labels are normalized at runtime.
- Existing deployments should set `APP_SUBTITLE` to the desired environment fallback if they do not have a church-level subtitle configured.
- Back up the application and database before installation as part of the normal managed update process.

## Verification

- Locale default and account override tests passed.
- Installer and system settings tests passed.
- Authentication branding tests passed.
- Website Studio navigation tests passed.
- Pint formatting checks passed.
- Blade view compilation passed.
- Git whitespace validation passed.
- The release workflow will run the complete application test suite, dependency audits, production asset build, sensitive-artifact checks, package creation, provenance attestation, and release asset verification before publishing.
